title: Instagram Scraper Pro input
description: Scrape Instagram posts, reels, comments, mentions and details from URLs or search.

directUrls.title: Instagram URLs
directUrls.description: One per line: profile (instagram.com/nike/ or @nike), profile ID, post or reel URL (shortcode or numeric ID), hashtag (instagram.com/explore/tags/travel/ or #travel), place (instagram.com/explore/locations/7538318/), share links and story links. Each URL's type decides what it can return. URLs take priority over Search.

resultsType.title: Content to scrape
enumTitles: Mentions — posts where a profile is tagged
Details (profile, hashtag, place or post info)
resultsType.description: One content type per run. Profiles → posts, reels, mentions or details. Posts/reels → details or comments. Hashtags and places → posts, reels or details.

resultsLimit.title: Max results per URL
resultsLimit.description: How many results to save for each URL or search hit. Comment replies (when turned on) are extra.

maxItems.title: Max results in total
maxItems.description: Stop the whole run after this many saved (and charged) results. 0 = no limit.

search.title: Search terms
search.sectionCaption: Or discover by search (used only when no URLs are given)
search.description: Comma-separated, e.g. "travel, fitness" for hashtags, "nike, adidas" for profiles, or "vintage shop copenhagen" for places. Hashtags without the #.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: What to search for. Found items are scraped with the "Content to scrape" setting.

searchLimit.title: Max search hits per term
searchLimit.description: How many hashtags, profiles or places to take from each search term.

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Only posts newer than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Relative ("3 days", "2 weeks", "6 months") or a date ("2024-09-05", "2024-09-05T13:22:04Z"). UTC. Leave empty for all posts. Profile scraping stops paging once it reaches older posts.

skipPinnedPosts.title: Skip pinned posts
skipPinnedPosts.description: Leave out posts pinned to the top of a profile (often old).

minLikes.title: Min likes
minLikes.description: Skip posts with fewer likes. Posts with hidden like counts are skipped when this is set. 0 = off.

minComments.title: Min comments
minComments.description: Skip posts with fewer comments. 0 = off.

isNewestComments.title: Newest comments first
isNewestComments.description: Fetch comments newest-first instead of Instagram's default "most relevant" order.

includeNestedComments.title: Include replies
includeNestedComments.description: Also save replies to comments, each as its own row with parentCommentId. Replies don't count toward "Max results per URL".

addParentData.title: Add parent data to each result
addParentData.description: Adds a parentData object to every row (the profile, hashtag, place or post it came from).

includeFailedInputs.title: Show failed inputs in the results
includeFailedInputs.description: Adds one row per input that returned nothing (status = blocked / not_found / private / no_results / invalid_input) with the reason and how to fix it. Never charged.

skipPreviouslyScraped.title: Skip results saved in previous runs
skipPreviouslyScraped.description: Remembers saved post, comment and profile IDs in a named key-value store, so scheduled runs only save (and charge) new items.

dedupeStoreName.title: Memory store name
dedupeStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store that remembers saved IDs. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

saveRawResponses.title: Save raw responses (debug)
saveRawResponses.description: Saves the first 2 raw Instagram responses per method to the key-value store (RAW_* records). Turn on only when the developer asks for it.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Instagram blocks datacenter IPs. Keep Apify Proxy with the RESIDENTIAL group.
